about: A box item's menu doesn't hold the player. rathena runs an item's script through a stand-in hidden NPC and frees the script as soon as it pauses, so the Dungeon Ticket's menu (select in its item script) comes with the stand-in's vanish, and no answer or close ever follows. Main kept the player held for good (no walking) with the menu, or after OK an invisible dialog; now the dialog goes with the stand-in and the player walks.
